name: 7-Segment Display
tagline: Classic numerical LED display for numbers, counters, and digital clocks
description: A 7-segment display consists of 7 individual LED segments arranged in a figure-8 pattern (labeled A through G) plus an optional decimal point (DP). Lighting specific segment combinations renders digits 0 through 9 and basic hexadecimal characters.

specs.forwardCurrent: 15mA to 20mA per segment (requires current limiting resistors 220Ω–330Ω)

pinout.pin: A, B, C, D, E, F, G
pinout.name: Segments
pinout.desc: Individual LED anodes (for Common Cathode) or cathodes (for Common Anode)

pinout.name: Common Pin
pinout.desc: Connected to GND (Common Cathode) or 5V (Common Anode)

wiringNote: Always place a 220Ω to 330Ω current limiting resistor in series with each segment line to prevent burning the LEDs.
libraryName: SevSeg (by Dean Reading) or direct GPIO array control
commonMistakes: Connecting directly to 5V without 220Ω current limiting resistors
Confusing Common Cathode (active-HIGH) with Common Anode (active-LOW) display types
